arxiv-2104-09773.title: Long-term impact of a primary school intervention on aspects of Einsteinian physics Journal: \PED
arxiv-2104-09773.creator: Kyla Adams, Roshan Dattatri, Tejinder Kaur, David Blair
arxiv-2104-09773.description: Abstract The physics that underpins modern technology is based on Einstein’s theories of relativity and quantum mechanics. Most school students complete their compulsory science education without being taught any of these Einsteinian concepts. Only those who take a specialised physics course have the opportunity to learn modern physics.

arxiv-2212-11950.title: Peek into the Future Camera-based Occupant Sensing in Configurable Cabins for Autonomous Vehicles
arxiv-2212-11950.creator: Avinash Prabu, Renran Tian, Lingxi Li, Jialiang Le, Srinivasan Sundararajan, Saeed Barbat
arxiv-2212-11950.description: Abstract The development of fully autonomous vehicles (AVs) can potentially eliminate drivers and introduce unprecedented seating design. However, highly flexible seat configurations may lead to occupants’ unconventional poses and actions. Understanding occupant behaviors and prioritize safety features become eye-catching topics in the AV research frontier.

arxiv-2401-06017.title: Simulating critical anion chemistry with indirect excitons
arxiv-2401-06017.creator: Krzysztof Myśliwy and Krzysztof Jachymski
arxiv-2401-06017.description: Abstract We study the effect of geometric constraints on the formation of indirect excitonic complexes with excess charge by considering the problem of two identical electrons moving in half-space subject to mutual Coulomb repulsion and the Coulomb attraction to a heavy hole of charge Z Z residing on a flat impenetrable surface.

arxiv-2401-07681.title: EFFECT OF TARGET SIGNALS AND DELAYS ON SPATIALLY SELECTIVE ACTIVE NOISE CONTROL FOR OPEN-FITTING HEARABLES
arxiv-2401-07681.description: Abstract Spatially selective active noise control (ANC) hearables are designed to reduce unwanted noise from certain directions while preserving desired sounds from other directions. In previous studies, the target signal has been defined either as the delayed desired component in one of the reference microphone signals or as the desired component in the error microphone signal without any delay.

arxiv-2411-06119.title: Scalable, Tokenization-Free Diffusion Model Architectures with Efficient Initial Convolution and Fixed-Size Reusable Structures for On-Device Image Generation
arxiv-2411-06119.creator: Sanchar Palit, Sathya Veera Reddy Dendi, Mallikarjuna Talluri, Raj Narayana Gadde
arxiv-2411-06119.description: Abstract Vision Transformers and U-Net architectures have been widely adopted in the implementation of Diffusion Models. However, each architecture presents specific challenges while realizing them on-device. Vision Transformers require positional embedding to maintain correspondence between the tokens processed by the transformer, although they offer the advantage of using fixed-size, reusable repetitive blocks following tokenization.

arxiv-2506-18319.title: Solution Methods and Perturbation Analysis for the Equality-Constrained Total Least Squares Problem over Reduced Biquaternions
arxiv-2506-18319.creator: Neha Bhadala † a
arxiv-2506-18319.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Neha Bhadala † a. This paper proposes a theoretical framework to address the reduced biquaternion equality-constrained total least squares (RBTLSE) problem. The objective is to find an approximate solution to the system A ​ X ≈ B AX\approx B , subject to linear constraints C ​ X = D CX=D , while explicitly accounting for errors in both the coefficient matrix A A and the observation matrix B B .

arxiv-2508-19408.title: 1-Bit Unlimited Sampling Beyond Fourier Domain: Low-Resolution Sampling of Quantization Noise
arxiv-2508-19408.creator: Václav Pavlíček, Ayush Bhandari
arxiv-2508-19408.description: Abstract Analog-to-digital converters (ADCs) play a critical role in digital signal acquisition across various applications, but their performance is inherently constrained by sampling rates and bit budgets. This bit budget imposes a trade-off between dynamic range (DR) and digital resolution, with ADC energy consumption scaling linearly with sampling rate and exponentially with bit depth.

arxiv-2606-06588.title: Demystifying Objectivity with Operator Algebra Quantum Error Correction
arxiv-2606-06588.creator: Marin Girard, Gong Cheng, ChunJun Cao

pmc-10760387.title: Treatment-prognostication-adjustment a new therapeutic idea by analyzing T cell immune checkpoint in tumor microenvironment by algorithm: A bibliometric analysis
pmc-10760387.creator: Shiwei Ma, Xin Wu, Zhongguang Wu, Qiangqiang Zhao
pmc-10760387.description: To evaluate the temporal and spatial distribution of the knowledge network about tumor microenvironment and prognoses and explore new research hot spots and trends. Articles and reviews on tumor microenvironment and prognoses in the Web of Science journal from January 1999 to April 2022 were included.

pmc-11401908.title: Proximity induced charge density wave in a graphene/1T-TaS2 heterostructure
pmc-11401908.creator: Nikhil Tilak, Michael Altvater, Sheng-Hsiung Hung, Choong-Jae Won, Guohong Li, Taha Kaleem, Sang-Wook Cheong, Chung-Hou Chung, Horng-Tay Jeng, Eva Y Andrei
pmc-11401908.description: The proximity-effect, whereby materials in contact appropriate each other’s electronic-properties, is widely used to induce correlated states, such as superconductivity or magnetism, at heterostructure interfaces. Thus far however, demonstrating the existence of proximity-induced charge-density-waves (PI-CDW) proved challenging. This is due to competing effects, such as screening or co-tunneling into the parent material, that obscured its presence.

pmc-11570330.title: Global, regional, and national burden of upper respiratory infections, 1990–2021: Findings from the Global Burden of Disease study 2021
pmc-11570330.creator: Shun-Xian Zhang, Yu-Juan Liu, En-Li Tan, Guo-Bing Yang, Yu Wang, Xiao-Jie Hu, Ming-Zi Li, Lei Duan, Shan Lv, Li-Guang Tian, Mu-Xin Chen, Fan-Na Wei, Qin Liu, Yan Lu, Shi-Zhu Li, Pin Yang, Jin-Xin Zheng
pmc-11570330.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundUpper respiratory infections (URIs) are common infectious diseases worldwide. Accurate and timely assessment of the disease burden of URIs is crucial for governments to develop comprehensive prevention and control strategies, and to allocate and utilize healthcare resources more efficiently.MethodsFor URIs in Global Burden of Disease (GBD) 2021 database, age-standardized incidence rates (ASIR), age-standardized prevalence rates (ASPR), age-standardized mortality rates (ASMR), disability-adjusted life-years (DALYs), and case numbers for incidence, prevalence, deaths, and DALYs across the globe, five socio-demographic index (SDI) regions, 21 geographical

pmc-11642037.title: The Association Between Major Depression and Alzheimer’s Disease Risk: Evidence from a 12-Year Longitudinal Study
pmc-11642037.creator: Anais Sevil-Pérez, Raúl López-Antón, Patricia Gracia-García, Concepción de la Cámara, Ana Gascón-Catalán, Javier Santabárbara
pmc-11642037.description: Background: The relationship between depression, particularly major depression (MD), as a risk factor for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) is well established; however, its precise role remains contested. Findings from the fourth wave of the ZARADEMP longitudinal study provide further insights into the association between MD and AD risk.

pmc-11655514.title: A dataset for 15N natural abundance of soil ammonia volatilization
pmc-11655514.creator: Lingyun Peng, Chaopu Ti, Bin Yin, Xiao Bai, Miao Li, Limin Tao, Xiaoyuan Yan
pmc-11655514.description: Investigating the sources of ammonia (NH3) in the atmosphere and the contribution of each source is essential for environmental pollution control. The presented dataset aims to provide 15N natural abundance (δ15N) data collected from different controlled treatments to fill the knowledge gap between insufficient data of soil δ15N-NH3 and accurately identifying atmospheric NH3 source apportionments.

pmc-12523409.title: EfficientNet-B3-Based Automated Deep Learning Framework for Multiclass Endoscopic Bladder Tissue Classification
pmc-12523409.creator: A A Abd El-Aziz, Mahmood A Mahmood, Sameh Abd El-Ghany, Nicola Longo
pmc-12523409.description: Background: Bladder cancer (BLCA) is a malignant growth that originates from the urothelial lining of the urinary bladder. Diagnosing BLCA is complex due to the variety of tumor features and its heterogeneous nature, which leads to significant morbidity and mortality. Understanding tumor histopathology is crucial for developing tailored therapies and improving patient outcomes.

pmc-12566231.title: Irreversible Plastic Flows and Sedimentary Ecological Entrapment: A Critical Review of Legacy Risks and Governance Strategies for Planetary Health
pmc-12566231.creator: Seong-Dae Moon, Su-Ok Hwang, Byeong-Hun Han, Dae-sik Hwang, Baik-Ho Kim, Cristina Andreoli, Andrea Zijno
pmc-12566231.description: Plastic pollution has emerged as a pervasive and systemic driver of ecological and biogeochemical disruption in freshwater and marine environments. Unlike natural materials that circulate within closed biogeochemical loops, synthetic polymers predominantly follow unidirectional and irreversible trajectories, a phenomenon we describe as “irreversible plastic transport.

pmc-12702158.title: Socioeconomic vulnerability and the management of domestic animal hosts in urban environments: a one health issue
pmc-12702158.creator: Ianei de Oliveira Carneiro, Thaís Auxiliadora dos Santos Mattos, Simone Martins Freitas, Nicole Hlavac, Mike Begon, Federico Costa, Hussein Khalil, Hernan Darío Argibay
pmc-12702158.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundWithin socioeconomically vulnerable communities, dogs and cats are also exposed to deficient sanitation infrastructure, conditions of mistreatment, and malnutrition. This scenario promotes the maintenance of pathogen reservoirs, posing risks to domestic and wild animals, as well as to humans. Considering this context, our objective is to demonstrate how socio-environmental conditions influence the reduction in quality of life and the vulnerability status of these animals, making them more prone to infections and the transmission of zoonotic pathogens.

pmc-12749524.title: Comparative genomic study of blaKPC-2-carrying multidrug-resistant Klebsiella pneumoniae in the United Arab Emirates
pmc-12749524.creator: Akela Ghazawi, Mohammed Elbediwi, Tibor Pal, Agnes Sonnevend, Ashrat Manzoor, Ihab Habib, Farah Al-Marzooq, Abiola Senok, Laurent Poirel, Mushtaq Khan
pmc-12749524.description: We performed whole-genome sequencing of three multidrug-resistant KPC-producing Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates recovered from patients in a tertiary-care hospital in Abu Dhabi, UAE, and conducted a comparative genomic analysis with previously reported blaKPC−2-positive isolates from the region. The study aimed to characterize acquired antimicrobial resistance genes (ARGs), assess their phylogenetic context, and analyze the plasmids carrying blaKPC−2.

pmc-12752335.title: The impact of creatine supplementation associated with resistance training on muscular strength and lean tissue mass in the aged: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12752335.creator: ShaoChun Liu, Nan Huang, WenJuan Wu, XinYe OuYang, Yun Luo, YanBiao Zhong, MaoYuan Wang, Li Xiao
pmc-12752335.description: BackgroundSarcopenia is an age-related decline in muscle strength and mass, which significantly impacts the quality of life for older adults. Resistance training (RT) is well established as an effective intervention for sarcopenia. Some studies suggest that additional benefits may be obtained when RT is combined with creatine supplement (Cr).

pmc-12809969.title: Early-phase laparoscopic skill acquisition in veterinary students: impact of 2D/3D vision and conventional/articulating instruments
pmc-12809969.creator: Jongchul Yun, Sungin Lee
pmc-12809969.description: BackgroundMinimally invasive surgery has been increasingly adopted for its advantages of reduced postoperative pain and faster recovery, underscoring the importance of structured basic skills training. In human medicine, robotic surgery addresses the limitations of conventional laparoscopy, but widespread adoption in veterinary practice is constrained by cost and logistics.

pmc-13601966.title: Informant Perspectives on the Quality of Life of Healthy Older People, and People With Dementia Living in the Community and Care Facilities
pmc-13601966.creator: Pascalle Bosboom, Hui Wen Quek, Amy Page, Kelly Banz, Osvaldo P Almeida, Leon Flicker, Nicola T Lautenschlager, Christopher Etherton‐Beer
pmc-13601966.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). ObjectivesQuality of life (QoL) ratings for people living with dementia appear to be influenced by several factors. This study examined how informant perspectives and place of residence influence agreement between self‐ and informant‐rated QoL of people living with dementia.MethodsThis cross‐sectional observational study included 74 healthy older controls, 80 community‐dwelling people living with dementia and 351 residing in residential care facilities (RCFs), along with their informants. Quality of life was assessed using the Quality of Life in Alzheimer's Disease (QoL‐AD) scale.

pmc-13681993.title: Structure-informed theoretical modeling defines principles governing avidity in bivalent protein interactions
pmc-13681993.creator: Reagan Portelance, Anqi Wu, Alekhya Kandoor, Kristen M Naegle
pmc-13681993.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In signaling cascades, signaling proteins often encode multiple domains or motifs, which presents the possibility for avidity—where multivalent binding drastically increases interaction strength and duration. However, predicting and validating multivalent interactions that interact with avidity is a challenge. Here, we integrate mechanistic modeling, structure-based analysis, and experimental approaches as a framework for defining the conditions under which avidity plays a role.

uslaw-fr-e9-26163.description: Notice published in the Federal Register on 2009-10-30 by Health and Human Services Department. Text from federalregister.gov (official edition: govinfo). [FR Doc No: E9-26163] ----------------------------------------------------------------------- DEPARTMENT OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES Designation of a Class of Employees for Addition to the Special Exposure Cohort AGENCY: National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH), Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). uslaw-usc-t40-s9102.title: 40 U.S.C. § 9102 — Duties
uslaw-usc-t40-s9102.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t40-s9102.description: United States Code, Title 40 (Public Buildings, Property, And Works); Part D (Public Buildings, Grounds, And Parks In The District Of Columbia); Chapter 91 (Commission Of Fine Arts). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) In General.— The Commission of Fine Arts shall advise on— (1) the location of statues, fountains, and monuments in the public squares, streets, and parks in the District.

uslaw-usc-t6-s321n.title: 6 U.S.C. § 321n — Acceptance of gifts
uslaw-usc-t6-s321n.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t6-s321n.description: United States Code, Title 6 (Domestic Security); Chapter 1 (Homeland Security Organization); Subchapter V (National Emergency Management). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Authority The Secretary may accept and use gifts of property, both real and personal, and may accept gifts of services, including from guest lecturers, for otherwise authorized activities of the Center for Domestic Preparedness that are related to efforts.
